requirement:
The coverage index MUST combine the most recent recorded test attempt for each
nextest binary and test name among the retained runs. "Most recent" MUST refer
to when the attempt started, including failed or interrupted attempts. A newer
filtered run MUST update only the tests it executes, leaving other compatible
test records available to the combined view. A newer attempt with missing or
unreadable coverage MUST be shown as unavailable rather than replaced with an
older successful attempt. Results from incompatible instrumented build
configurations MUST NOT be combined under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.storage.configuration`.

The main combined view MUST use the instrumented build configuration of the
most recently started recorded test attempt. Latest-per-test selection MUST
occur within that configuration. Records from other configurations MUST be
identified as excluded historical coverage. Configuration selection MUST use
recorded metadata without building or executing tests.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation in `requirements.test-coverage.index.selection`. I did not request implementation source; I judged only from the supplied test text.

- **Per-binary and per-test-name selection:** In `selection_distinguishes_binaries_and_selects_latest_attempts_within_the_active_build`, two binaries each have a test named `same`. The test expects `2/2 (100.0%)` and both `first / same` and `second / same` rows. A selection keyed on test name alone would keep only the newer record and give 1/2.
- **"Most recent" means attempt start:** The same test writes records newest first. It sets run start and UUID ordering to disagree with attempt-start ordering, and it expects `2/2`. A third scenario adds a retry inside one run, where the older attempt has the largest UUID and a zero line count. It expects `1/1 (100.0%)`, so only attempt-start ordering passes.
- **Filtered runs update only their tests:** `filtered_runs_union_latest_attempts_and_invalidate_with_saved_source` records `one` and then `two`, each covering a different line. It expects the combined `2/2 (100.0%)`, so the older records for tests the newer run did not execute stay available.
- **Failed and interrupted attempts count:** The same test adds a newer attempt for `one` with no data and a diagnostic. It runs this once with outcome `failed` and once with `interrupted`. It expects `1/2 (50.0%)` and `unavailable: incomplete`, so the older success is not reused.
- **Unreadable or missing coverage is unavailable:** `unreadable_history_cannot_reintroduce_an_older_success` covers four cases.
  - A newer `attempt.json` that is not valid JSON, over an older success. The test expects "cannot establish latest-per-test selection" and no `1/1`.
  - A missing captured source, which is reported as unavailable incomplete coverage.
  - An unsupported run schema, reported as "latest attempt history cannot be established".
  - A missing raw profile, reported as unavailable incomplete coverage.
- **Incompatible configurations are not combined:** The second scenario in the first test and the last part of the `filtered_runs_union…` test both exclude other configurations.
  - In the first test, the active configuration is build-a, whose latest attempt started at 40. The build-b record has a run start of 1000 but an attempt start of 20, so run-start ordering would pick the wrong configuration. The test expects `2/2 (100.0%)` and the text "excluded: historical build configuration".
  - In the `filtered_runs_union…` test, a newer build-b attempt becomes the active configuration. The test expects `1/1 (100.0%)`, so the build-a `two` record is not merged in, and it expects "historical build configuration".
- **Selection by recorded metadata, with no building or execution:** `book_rendering_preserves_retained_coverage_and_never_launches_tests` in `tests/execution_coverage.rs` runs the preprocessor with a `cargo` shim. It asserts that only `metadata` calls occur, that no forbidden command ran, that the test-binary sentinel was not written, and that retained files are unchanged.

I found no unexercised obligation. One case is not tested directly: a failed attempt in another configuration deciding which configuration is active. The text does not call it out beyond "most recently started recorded test attempt", and the ordering by attempt start is tested. The compatibility rules themselves belong to the cited `requirements.test-coverage.storage.configuration`, which I did not reassess.

test records available to the combined view. A newer attempt with missing or

configurations MUST NOT be combined under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.storage.configuration`.
The main combined view MUST use the instrumented build configuration of the
most recently started recorded test attempt. Latest-per-test selection MUST
occur within that configuration. Records from other configurations MUST be
identified as excluded historical coverage. Configuration selection MUST use
recorded metadata without building or executing tests.
:::{req} storage.configuration
Each coverage record MUST identify the recorded toolchain, compilation target,
Cargo build profile, enabled features, and instrumentation-affecting compiler
settings. These settings MUST determine build-configuration compatibility for
the combined view. A nextest scheduling profile alone MUST NOT make otherwise
compatible build configurations incompatible.
